title: Architecture-scoped FRZ-PRD-04/05/06/07/09/10/11/12 are OPEN with PROD-Q as sole closing stage; PRD-06 and PRD-11 cite no PROD-Q evidence despite recorded P3 contributions
affected_invariant: ARCH-FREEZE mechanical entry (roadmap L499): architecture-scoped checklist OPEN = 0
impact: Path B (checklist L66) lists only PRD-01/02 and the live parts of PRD-03/08 as live-scoped; the other PRD rows are architecture-scoped and must be PASS or N/A at ARCH-FREEZE, yet they are OPEN, owned by PROD-Q (stage CLOSED SCOPED, parent OPEN for the live slice), and the matrix plans only 'close via audit+promotion'. PRD-06 shows no evidence and PRD-11 only cross-references, although roadmap L482 and the PROD-Q qualification record list P3 scoped contributions (degraded-state projection, local capacity admission). Either the rows need an explicit live/architecture split or an architecture-scoped closure path.
recommendation: Owner to (a) state per row which part is architecture-scoped vs live-scoped, (b) cite the existing P3 evidence in PRD-06/11, (c) schedule independent audit and promotion of the architecture-scoped parts before ARCH-FREEZE.
